UltraTech Cement Acquires Stake in Solaris Horizon for Green Energy

UltraTech Cement is acquiring a 26% stake in Solaris Horizon. This acquisition is intended to support UltraTech Cement's green energy requirements. Separately, Pilani Investment plans to sell 1.7 million shares of UltraTech Cement for ₹1,908 crore.
